ablation: Remove only READY gate of gain learning. Keep b rule and caps.
training_duration: Fixed for every seed, rule and noise level; no filtering by preparation.
tests: Independent held-out 24 and 128 pulse trains; matched noise; active and frozen copies; same initial learned state.
additional_controls: Deterministic clean normal training of same length, matched held-out noisy tests for all levels and seeds; frozen normal transfer tests across all three levels.
primary_endpoint: At layer 130, fraction of source labels occurring exactly once; complete ordered word on all 12 lanes separately.
statistics: Paired seed bootstrap 95% CI (20000 resamples); exact paired sign tests, Holm correction for 3 noise-level comparisons. Seeds, not lanes or pulses, are replicate units.
cessation: Report tail128 gains and b increments, cap fractions; finite observation only, no theorem of permanent stopping under unbounded noise.
randomness: New SplitMix64 counter field, Box-Muller normal, keyed by seed/layer/lane/port/stage/label/occurrence. Same standardized perturbations between compared conditions; train stage=0, test stages=24 and 128. Not a replay of previous seeds.
cross_level_tests: Only frozen normal at 128 pulses; matched primary 128 active.
